The Services Central Marketing team at Apple is responsible for cultivating awareness and education of Apple's full suite of services and driving new customer acquisition through a variety of marketing channels, including paid media, organic social, partnerships, GEO, and more.
Our growing team is looking for a Strategic Media Planning Lead supporting services across B2B and B2C verticals. This role will collaborate closely with channel teams, marketing leads, creative strategists and analytics to build data-informed recommendations and campaigns. Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills are essential, along with the ability to prioritize, adapt to change and multi-task within a dynamic environment.
You will be responsible for developing paid media and cross-channel strategies within Apple Services that drive full funnel and measurable impact for the business. Additionally, you will manage workflow between our internal channel teams and business stakeholders, and the implementation of each strategy. You will analyze the performance of marketing channels and provide insights to ensure key partners understand plans, optimizations and results.
On top of developing sophisticated marketing strategies, you will position yourself as the strategic thought leader for your business stakeholders and provide direction on how to reach their desired audience via marketing channels, how to allocate budgets effectively for their objectives, and you’ll also provide insight on branding and messaging within creative. Your ability to clearly communicate challenges, solutions, recommendations, and perspectives will be integral to the team’s success in a constantly evolving environment. This is a highly visible role and requires strong relationship building and cross-functional communication skills in addition to the strategic marketing expertise outlined above.
Minimum qualifications: 8+ years media planning and strategy experience, either at an agency or in-house.
Expertise in end-to-end campaign planning and management for full funnel KPIs including awareness, engagement, and performance.
Familiarity with digital advertising, social media platforms, custom partnerships, Above The Line (OOH, Audio) and their relationship with each other in multifaceted, integrated campaigns.
Demonstrated ability to leverage data and insights to develop marketing strategies that reach a defined audience through the right channels, and tie back to business objectives.
Track record of measuring impact and growth through different testing and measurement solutions with the ability to share results and future recommendations in a digestible way.
BS/BA degree required.
Preferred qualifications: A self-starter who can work autonomously with agility, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects at one time
Understanding of how the presence of AI is evolving the digital world, and how that impacts marketing channels, particularly advertising and GEO.
Experience working with earned and owned social teams, and particularly has been involved with creator partnerships.
Excellent presentation, written and verbal communication skills.
App growth and engagement experience a plus.
B2B Marketing experience a plus.

title: Strategic Space Planner
description:
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s corporate and retail workplaces and workplace services. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world.
The Space Planning team is responsible for establishing and driving efficient real estate strategies that support Apple's corporate space needs. We're hiring a Strategic Space Planner: an individual contributor who will be dedicated to Americas (AMR) geographic markets to lead strategic planning and migration across the portfolio.
You'll drive occupancy strategy and implementation across the AMR portfolio, ensuring space supply proactively aligns with business demand. As an action-oriented workplace strategist, you'll lead end-to-end space planning initiatives and collaborate closely with business units to translate their location strategies into scalable workplace solutions.
You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, proactively seeking clarification, weighing competing priorities against business impact, and adapting plans as business requirements evolve. You bring a data analytics background to evaluate utilization metrics, analyze capacity forecasts, and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations that optimize the portfolio.
Minimum qualifications: 3-5 years of experience in workplace strategy, strategic space planning, or corporate occupancy planning, preferably within a technology company or corporate campus.
Experience managing multiple space planning projects from conception through implementation.
Experience applying occupancy metrics, space utilization analysis, and scenario modeling to inform stakeholder decisions.
Experience synthesizing spatial data into visual presentations and business cases for executive audiences.
Experience negotiating space allocations and resolving competing stakeholder priorities.
Working knowledge of Computer-Aided Facility Management (CAFM) and Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) platforms such as (Serraview, Archibus, Tririga, or FM:Systems).
Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in Real Estate (MRED), Urban Planning, Architecture, or Business Administration (MBA), with 2 years of experience.
Proficiency in Keynote and business intelligence or data visualization platforms, such as Tableau, Power BI, or advanced Excel modeling.
Familiarity with project management platforms, such as Wrike.
Understanding of architectural drawings, test-fits, building code implications, and core-and-shell conditions.
Experience leveraging AI-driven tools to accelerate scenario planning, optimize multi-floor stacking diagrams, and analyze space data.
Skilled at influencing stakeholders and communicating complex trade-offs clearly to drive alignment.

title: System Engineering Program Manager (EPM) - Vision Products
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. It will allow us to do the things we love in ways never before possible — all while staying connected to the people around us.
We are looking for an experienced, highly technical EPM to join the team driving product definition, system engineering and integration/validation of a new product category. If you have broad experience across various key hardware enablers (e.g displays, cameras, sensors, wearables), a strong product/customer focus, experience guiding complex programs through the entire development process, and the ability to distill tradeoffs down to key factors and drive critical product decisions we’d love to hear from you.
As a System EPM, you will work closely with system engineering, electrical, mechanical, algorithm and software teams in VPG and across the company to define and develop highly optimized hardware products. You will be responsible for:
Driving the cross-functional development of requirements and validation plan at product, system and module level, based on experience targets and technology constraints. Identifying the most critical questions and organizing teams to find efficient ways to get answers. Understanding the link between technical decisions for the system and customer experience and communicating impacts clearly and concisely. Driving resolution to architectural/integration gaps to feed into subsequent engineering builds.
Minimum qualifications: BS/MS EE/CE/CS/ME or equivalent work experience
3+ yrs of relevant hardware engineering experience in consumer electronics
3+ yrs of project management experience managing cross-functional teams across various program stages (architecture, integration, validation)
Understanding of consumer electronics system architectures
Demonstrated ability to work through system-level development tradeoffs
Developed skills for planning and executing development in advanced consumer electronics products - both prototype build events and overall product planning
Strong technical background in Electrical, Mechanical, or Software Engineering
Proactive and highly self-motivated; good critical thinking capabilities and strong attention to detail
Ability to operate well in an environment with rapid development cycles and constant change
Willingness to travel internationally to support development builds
Preferred qualifications: Experience with camera systems, display and optics technologies, and/or wearable consumer electronics
Experience driving a highly diverse set of cross-functional team members and perspectives and yielding the best possible product solution
Experience as primary point of contact with vendors and CM partners to establish a daily build plan, provide clear direction and guidance to meet the program and build objectives

title: Systems Architect
description:
Apple’s Ecosystem Products & Technologies team is looking for a highly skilled and motivated product-focused Systems Architect with a passion for creating great user experiences and high quality products. Join a collaborative development team that plays a pivotal role in the development of products that seamlessly integrate with Apple’s portfolio, encompassing Home, iPad, iPhone, Watch, Mac and Vision Pro. This ecosystem of products is unique for its tight integration between accessories and Apple devices that extends the Apple user experience.
We are seeking a highly motivated, energetic Systems Architect to lead and drive system technical designs and roadmaps. You will oversee and analyze key system architectural and implementation trade-offs, such as power and performance in a thermally constrained system, analyzing hardware & data flows, and driving requirements.
This role requires that you have strong communication skills, listening/understanding, synthesizing, presenting options & tradeoffs, all while being comfortable with working through ambiguities. In this position, you will:
*Work with multi-discipline teams to design and launch new accessories and features into the market
*Decompose user facing features, experiences, and functions into associated enabling technologies
*Lay out available architectural options, analyze engineering trade-offs, and articulate recommendations to meet product goals
*Work cross-functionally to understand existing portfolio of technologies, derive capabilities & cost functions, and construct an overall end-to-end product solution
*Define and author system level feature descriptions and detailed functional requirements
*Shepherd product features through idea/concept to execution
*Review, influence, and challenge architectural tradeoffs with data and innovative new ideas
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in electrical or computer engineering or similar field
10 years interdisciplinary engineering expertise related to consumer electronics or embedded systems (firmware, hardware/electrical, and/or mechanical)
5 years developing consumer products from concept to production as a system integrator
Solid understanding of hardware/software interaction and mechanical constraints
Ability to develop and maintain product-specific system-level requirements/specifications for hardware, software/firmware, and mechanical subsystems
Excellent written and oral communication skills including producing concise and clear engineering specifications as well as presenting to engineering leadership
Ability to build relationships with cross-functional teams and exert effective influence
Some international travel may be required
Preferred qualifications: Master’s Degree in electrical or computer engineering or similar field
10 years product development experience in a matrix organization, preferably high volume consumer
3 years experience as a technical lead or engineering manager
History of shipping interoperability and ecosystem features
Proven expertise in SoC architecture, low-power design, HW/SW interfaces, bus protocols (USB, I2C, etc.), and wireless interfaces (Bluetooth/BLE, NFC, Wi-Fi, Thread)
Working knowledge of HW/SW interaction, operating systems, estimation of compute workload, thermal, and power controls in modern SoCs
Previous exposure to PCB technologies, signal integrity considerations, coex/desense mitigation
Ability to think strategically, while driving tactical details
Systems thinking mindset with attention to interface definitions and edge cases
Experience working with teams of diverse technical backgrounds and quickly seeking and integrating their knowledge

title: Systems Software Engineer - Human Interface Devices
description:
Our Human Interface Devices Software team delivers high-quality drivers, frameworks and tools supporting sensing technologies across all Apple products. Primarily supporting the multi-touch technology, we have deep experience developing systems software and building stacks that enable the best user-experience! We work closely with Algorithms, Firmware, Design, and UI teams to ensure sensor and software performance is optimized across all layers of the stack.
We are looking for an engineer to work on drivers, frameworks, and tools for iOS. In this role, you will maintain existing software and design new software stacks for future products and sensing technologies. Ideally, you have experience dealing with human factors, care deeply about user experience, enjoy supporting technology investigations, and are comfortable jumping between multiple levels of the software stack.
Minimum qualifications: BS and 3 years of relevant industry experience
Experience developing system software; such as drivers or frameworks
Strong C/C++ and object-oriented programming skills
Excellent debugging skills
Ability to quickly familiarize yourself with code you’ve never seen before, and understand the pertinent functionality
Comfortable working at both higher and lower levels of software
Experience using AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity in system software development flows, creating test frameworks and tooling, and improve overall code quality.
Preferred qualifications: 6 years of experience in developing embedded software, including firmware and device drivers
Using C/C++ for low level systems, and experience designing and implementing system software for drivers
Experience in Kernel driver development, including designing and implementing kernel drivers for various hardware sensors in Unix, Linux or iOS
Experience in designing and implementing SW interfaces/APIs among software, firmware and algorithms modules
Experience with profiling code in both kernel and userspace
Experience in debugging embedded system issues with hardware, assembly and software tracers
Strong verbal and written communications skills
Self-advised, analytical, and works well in a team environment

title: Test Engineering Manager, AppleCare Service Engineering
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
The people here at Apple don’t just craft products - they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it.
As a Test Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of engineers, and technicians responsible for enabling and sustaining factory test lines in Cupertino that support all Apple hardware products pre and post New Product Introduction (NPI). These factory test lines are an important asset to Apple, as these enable product quality continuous improvement (activities such as EFFA and QIF) and facilitate the development of field diagnostics and repair processes. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional engineering partners to develop test plans and schedules, and ultimately lead the team to execute on those agreements and deliver factory testing capability and capacity when needed by our partners.
Responsibilities include providing leadership during all planning, engineering, and procurement activities to enable automated test line bring-up and continuity:
Responsibilities include providing test engineering leadership during all test station planning and execution to enable test line bring-up and continuity.
Collaborate with Hardware Engineering, Product Quality and AppleCare cross-functional partners and leadership to gain agreement on test coverage and support requirements for NPI and sustaining support as it relates to but not limited to as-is, trade-in and RMAO business.
Understand automated test station functionality as it relates to the product features and responsible for BOM review discussions and finalization of equipment requirements.
Collaborate with global vendors for automated test station bring-up and own the engineering deliverables for overall readiness.
Assign test engineers and technicians during planning phase to execute deliverables for each product test line. These include line layout, test equipment requirements, budget, schedule, system updates, and engineering resources (DRI and temporary) forecasts.
Facilitate and be the gatekeeper for equipment purchasing by collaborating with test engineers and PM’s. Collaborate with PM’s to present budget to the Finance/PQM stakeholders and AppleCare leadership.
Provide engineering leadership during execution of test line plans, installation, qualification and troubleshooting of issues blocking test line readiness for all product lines.
Maintain communication with cross-functional partners during product lifecycle to revisit test line support requirements. Manage team engineering resources as needed to support ongoing test line operations.
Provide mentorship to Test Engineering team members.
Minimum qualifications: BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Science.
10 years of industry work experience, with 5 years in a people management role, in Test Engineering, Product Quality, or Technical Operations.
Technical leader with established track record of managing engineering teams, including Test Engineering and/or Product Quality responsibilities.
Experience managing the qualification and maintenance of automated test processes & screening procedures.
Ability to identify and communicate improvements for current test, operations, & business processes.
Strong analytical skills and experience with statistical analysis tools.
Experience collaborating with network, security, and infrastructure function.
A solution-oriented work ethic with a high degree of flexibility in supporting multiple projects with a range of complexity & priority.
Previous track record working with cross-functional/interdisciplinary teams.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to communicate complex items in simple language.
Experience presenting at all levels of the organization, from individual contributors to senior leadership.
High attention to detail.
Ability to travel as required.
Preferred qualifications: MBA is considered a plus.
Passion for problem solving and identifying root cause.

title: Thin-Film/ALD Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Thin-film /ALD Engineer with a strong background in vacuum systems to lead technical initiatives and process improvements as related to device performance. This individual will play a critical role in ensuring equipment performance, safety compliance, documentation, training and process improvement to help the organization improve.
This is a hands-on role that requires independent judgment, broad engineering insight, and a passion for solving complex equipment and process challenges. The ideal candidate will contribute to continuous improvement, foster a culture of safety and accountability, and bring a deep understanding of both the technical and operational aspects of the job.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelors with 3+ years of experience in module engineering or technical support roles, with a strong knowledge of vacuum and thin film systems.
Preferred qualifications: Proven ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and lead by example
Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and process-related systems
Commitment to safety-first thinking and continuous improvement
Excellent communication and organizational skills
Background in industries such as semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, R&D, capital equipment, or related fields
Familiarity with a variety of process or manufacturing equipment
Experience working as both an equipment provider and end user

title: UI Frameworks Engineer, Swift Platform Experience
description:
Do you want to help define the future of app development? Join the UI Frameworks team and empower developers to build better apps with less code. You’ll collaborate with passionate and creative colleagues to meet ambitious goals in an environment that not only encourages, but requires constant curiosity and growth. The work we do together will shape the developer experience on Apple's platforms and beyond for decades to come!
As an engineer on the UI Frameworks team, you will develop features and APIs across SwiftUI and UIKit that impact all of Apple’s platforms and delight over a billion users. You will be responsible for bringing your ideas to life through all stages of their development: from initial research, to API design and proposals, to testing and development in Swift, to documentation and offering guidance to adopters. Youʼll join us in energetic discussions on each otherʼs work and ideas, alongside members of other teams possessing a variety of different perspectives and domain expertise. The UI Frameworks team is responsible for the core SwiftUI and UIKit frameworks and works closely with UI framework teams across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS. Youʼll also have the opportunity to collaborate with experts throughout Apple including: compiler engineers, interface designers, and technical writers. Curious and enterprising individuals who take an expansive view of their role will thrive in this multi-disciplinary environment! Our goal is to dramatically improve the correctness, performance, and polish of apps across all of Appleʼs platforms — simultaneously making it easier for beginners to get started and empowering seasoned pros to make their apps shine. Because we have the privilege of collaborating closely with the Swift, Xcode, design, and framework teams up and down the software stack, we believe Apple's UI frameworks can be — by far — the best app development experience in the world. If youʼre interested in helping define this future and pushing the state of the art forward, weʼd love to hear from you!
Minimum qualifications: Proficiency with Swift (or the capacity to become proficient quickly)
The ability to work collaboratively and explain complex ideas clearly
Experience with at least one of the following: native or web app development, framework and API development, graphics and animation systems
Bachelorʼs Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
Preferred qualifications: High standards for quality and attention to detail
The desire to learn and grow, keeping pace with cutting edge technologies

title: US-Lead
description:
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.
As a Lead, you embody a whole-store mindset and are integral to supporting the Store Leadership team, playing a critical role in facilitating meaningful experiences for both customers and team members. You inform and energize our teams to do their best work and contribute to operational excellence. You actively connect with team members, making sure everyone is equipped with the support, tools, and resources they need to deliver exceptional customer interactions.
A Lead works alongside the leadership team to ensure operational readiness, with a focus on enabling the sales team. You spend the majority of your time with the team and customers, identifying ownership opportunities and supporting team members across the whole store.
Lead, act as a role model, mentor, and encourage customer engagement.
Use Apple product and services expertise to drive customer engagement and sales, while building customer loyalty.
Organize people and the sales floor workflow, including managing relevant communication to team members and leadership to optimize the customer experience.
Make sure that sales strategy is effectively communicated to the team in a timely manner and executed in partnership with the leadership team.
Energize, inform, and align team members on store performance goals, priorities, and communication.
Attend to time-sensitive team member feedback, questions, and concerns, and escalate issues to Store Leadership as appropriate.
Address operational needs of the store, such as opening and closing procedures, cash management, and overrides.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.
Minimum qualifications: You should:
Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
Have experience in retail or sales, or related work experience.
Have experience mentoring or leading others personally or professionally.
Preferred qualifications: You can:
Motivate others to achieve performance goals by fostering open dialog, collaboration, and recognition.
Resolve conflict and settle differences in productive ways.
Work in a fast-paced environment and make timely decisions using analytics, experience, and judgment.
Demonstrate excellent attention to detail and organization skills.
Work autonomously and be willing to take initiative without close supervision.
Drive results both individually and through enabling others by leading and collaborating.
Allocate resources and adjust processes to provide an exceptional customer experience.
Communicate effectively and tailor your communication style to different audiences.

title: iPhone Hardware System Design Electrical Engineer
description:
Imagine the world without Apple devices! Does it feel strange?
Apple products might even be one of the reasons you wanted to BE a Hardware Design Engineer. Now, imagine yourself designing future Apple products.
Designing hardware for iPhone means learning how to build high-performance electronics where every cubic millimeter matters. It is a masterclass in modern hardware engineering—blending high-speed digital buses, ultra-low-noise power rails, and flexible circuits into an integrated system built at unprecedented quality and scale.
The iPhone Hardware System Design team is looking for a driven Electrical Engineer who is passionate about circuit design, board-level bring-up, and hands-on problem solving. You will own the design, validation, and integration of critical rigid-board and flexible-circuit modules, working side-by-side with world-class engineers. If you are eager to dive deep into schematics, spend time in the lab probing waveforms, and see your designs ship in products used by millions, join us.
In this role, you will be an active contributor to the hardware design and validation cycle of future iPhone hardware:
Circuit Design & Integration: Own schematics, component selection and collaborate closely with CAD layout engineers for dedicated rigid boards, flexible printed circuits (FPCs), and system interconnect modules.
Hands-On Lab Bring-Up: Lead the first-time power-on and functional bring-up of your hardware blocks in the lab; debug hardware bugs down to component level using high-speed scopes and digital analyzers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner daily with mechanical engineering (Product Design), firmware, thermal, silicon, and factory teams to ensure smooth mechanical and electrical integration.
There will be opportunities for international travel.
Minimum qualifications: BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
2+ years of experience in board-level electrical hardware design and verification.
Strong grasp of core EE fundamentals: circuit theory, analog fundamentals, digital logic, and basic power regulation.
Demonstrated hands-on lab experience bringing up and debugging prototype hardware.
Preferred qualifications: High speed digital design
Schematic capture and PCB layout
Hands-on lab experience with hardware bring-up and debug
Fundamentals of signal and power integrity
Understanding of low voltage power regulation solutions
Integration of hardware into multi-functional systems
Use of scripting languages to assist with hardware development
Familiarity with the challenges of taking a product from design through to production
Excellent Verbal, written and presentation skills
Experience working with dynamic multi-functional teams
Automation: Proficiency with tools to enable automation (AI usage to develop tools and for other efficiency improvements is a plus)

title: iPhone Hardware Systems Engineer - SOC & System Performance
description:
At Apple, people don't just build products. They build the kind of wonder that has reshaped entire industries. The diversity of our people and ideas drives the innovation behind everything we do, from breakthrough technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it.
The iPhone System Engineering team is looking for an Engineer who is passionate about how iPhone performs. You will measure, model, and tune the power, performance, and thermal behavior of future iPhone SoCs and systems. You will work with a collaborative team that cares about getting the details right and about making the right architectural trade-offs
Our team is collaborative and we are passionate about what we do. Come join us!
In this role, you will:
Get your hands on real SOC silicon and real iPhone systems: Run hands-on performance and power measurements with hardware and software tools. Dig into the data, find the root cause of unexpected behavior, and turn what you learn into clear optimization opportunities.
Architect for the trade-off: Analyze system behavior across the CPU, GPU, Neural Engine, and memory subsystem. Weigh power, performance, and thermal constraints against each other, and help decide where the next iPhone SoC and system should invest its power and silicon budget.
Project the future: Build models, analyses, and simulations that project performance for upcoming iPhone products. Use them to influence architectural decisions across the hardware and software stack.
Sweat the details: Correlate models with measurements and question assumptions. Make sure the numbers behind each design decision hold up to scrutiny.
Partner broadly: Work with silicon, hardware, and software teams, and present findings and recommendations to engineering and executive leadership to guide product direction.
Minimum qualifications: BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and 3+ years of industry experience.
Experience in computer, SoC, or system architecture for mobile devices.
Hands-on experience measuring performance with hardware and software tools.
Experience in performance modeling, analysis, and debug.
Strong programming skills in Python, and experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis and development.
A detail-driven mindset, with the rigor to validate data and models before drawing conclusions.
Genuine passion for system performance and for building great products.
Preferred qualifications: MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science
7+ years of industry experience in performance modeling and/or analysis
Deep understanding of the hardware that drives performance, including the CPU, GPU, Neural Engine, and memory
Strong grasp of how power and thermal limits shape system performance, and experience architecting trade-offs among power, performance, and thermal at the SoC or system level
Hands-on experience developing simulators or performance analysis tools
Good interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex trade-offs clearly to both technical and executive audiences

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
Job Description:
About Crowe Studio
Crowe Studio is a business unit dedicated to helping clients scale smarter, transform faster, and lead in a platform-driven economy. Built for speed and flexibility, Crowe Studio operates outside the constraints of traditional professional services delivery models, giving clients access to cross-disciplinary innovation, embedded AI capabilities, and global delivery resources—all in service of solving complex business challenges in faster, smarter ways.
Through Crowe Studio, the firm provides clients with an innovation partner focused on rapid execution, deep technology integration, and high-impact results. We’re building the next generation of business models for professional services, where human expertise and AI are embedded within clients’ operations to drive ongoing impact, not just deliver isolated projects.
As a member of Crowe Studio, you will help distinguish Crowe in the market and drive the firm’s technology and innovation strategy. The future is powered by AI—come build it with us.
About Forward Deployed Engineering
The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Practice drives AI transformation through embedded consulting and engineering, enabling clients to accelerate delivery, scale solutions, and capture value faster. Our approach helps companies prove AI in their own environments, delivering results in weeks, not months.
We embed our Forward Deployed Engineers side-by-side with client teams to spot opportunities, make AI concepts real, and deploy solutions rapidly. Unlike traditional consulting approaches that rely on documented requirements and lengthy development cycles, FDEs blend engineering, product thinking, workflow design, and business understanding to achieve shared, outcome-driven ownership until measurable results are achieved.
Our engagements range from 2-hour AI Immersion Labs that turn AI noise into real use cases, to multi-week Proof of Value Sprints that prototype and deploy game-changing AI solutions. We help companies de-risk AI adoption while demonstrating solid ROI.
About the Team
We invest in expertise . You’ll have the time, space, and support to go deep on client engagements and build lasting technical and strategic mastery. You’ll work with cross-functional teams and client teams as a trusted advisor and domain expert.
We believe in continuous growth . Our team is committed to professional development and knowledge-sharing.
We protect balance . Our distributed team culture is grounded in trust and flexibility. We offer unlimited PTO, a flexible remote work policy, and a supportive environment that prioritizes sustainable, long-term performance.
About the Role
As a Forward Deployed AI Architect (Manager), you will serve as a hands-on technical authority responsible for designing, developing, and delivering innovative, production-ready AI solutions for our clients. You will own solution architecture, technical feasibility, engineering quality, and production readiness while remaining actively involved in coding, prototyping, and complex technical problem-solving.
Working within Crowe Studio's Forward Deployed Engineering practice, you will collaborate directly with clients and cross-functional teams to translate complex business challenges into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI applications. Your work will span agentic AI systems, generative AI applications, enterprise integrations, cloud-native architectures, and production deployments.
This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who wants to expand their technical leadership and architectural influence without moving away from hands-on engineering. You will guide technical decisions, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and communicate architectural tradeoffs with confidence. You will also be empowered to challenge technical approaches that introduce unacceptable risk or will not meet production requirements.
What You’ll Do
Architect and develop end-to-end applied AI solutions, including generative AI applications, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI-enabled enterprise workflows.
Lead solution architecture for AI build and proof-of-concept engagements, ensuring solutions are technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives.
Remain hands-on across solution development, including application coding, data integration, prototyping, debugging, and technical implementation.
Design and implement cloud-native AI solutions using Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and relevant AI platforms and services.
Define architecture and integration patterns for large language models (LLMs), vector databases, APIs, microservices, enterprise data platforms, and client systems.
Take ownership of technical feasibility, solution design decisions, and build quality from initial discovery through production deployment.
Guide solutions through Architecture Review Board processes, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, responsible AI principles, and production readiness expectations.
Assess technical feasibility during client discovery sessions, solution scoping, and sales support discussions, clearly communicating technical tradeoffs, risks, and recommended approaches.
Establish engineering standards, reusable architectural patterns, technical documentation, and development best practices across client engagements.
Design solutions with appropriate evaluation frameworks, monitoring, observability, guardrails, and performance optimization to support reliable AI operations.
Collaborate with AI engineering, data engineering, MLOps, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and security teams to deliver integrated enterprise solutions.
Evaluate technical tradeoffs among custom development, managed AI services, and low-code or automation platforms to select appropriate implementation strategies.
Identify and address technical risks, including performance, scalability, security, reliability, and cost considerations.
Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and hands-on problem-solving to strengthen engineering quality and team capabilities.
Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, cloud capabilities, and engineering tools to identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement.

description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last-mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!
About the Role
The Simulation team builds software, models, and environments to test on-road autonomous robot behavior and evaluate autonomy changes before deployment. We are hiring an Autonomy Simulation Engineer to improve simulation fidelity and accelerate the development and validation of autonomous delivery robots.
You will develop production simulation software and models of robot behavior and interactions with the environment, using real-world data and repeatable experiments to calibrate and validate them. Working closely with autonomy and robotics engineers, you will own projects from design through validation and report to the Simulation Lead. We expect this role to be hybrid, with some time in-office and some time remote.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Develop and maintain the simulation engine and supporting software.
Build and improve simulation models of robot behavior, other participants, and their interactions.
Calibrate and validate simulation models against real-world behavior using controlled, repeatable experiments.
Develop parameterized environments and synthetic scenarios to test conditions and interactions that are difficult to capture in the field.
Investigate differences between simulated and real-world behavior, identify contributing model assumptions and parameters, and implement improvements.
Improve simulator reproducibility, reliability, usability, and debuggability.
We’re excited about you because…
You have strong production C++ and Python experience.
You can translate real-world behavior and physical systems into practical software models.
You have experience building closed-loop or interactive simulation software, with depth in areas such as robot dynamics, physics, road-user behavior, synthetic scenario generation, or probabilistic modeling.
You have used real-world data and controlled, repeatable experiments to test, calibrate, or validate software models.
You have experience debugging complex systems and delivering reliable production software using Linux, Git, automated testing, and CI.
Experience applying machine learning to simulation modeling and validating learned models against real-world data is a plus.

DoorDash Parcel is building a new package delivery business on top of the largest local delivery network in the US, including millions of Dashers (our independent delivery partners), thousands of merchants, and DashMart (our own local fulfillment sites). Rather than copying traditional carriers, we are designing a software-driven network that delivers same-day and next-day at a cost per package customers will love. We are a small, highly autonomous team that builds with AI by default and works directly with the leaders running the business.
About the Role
We’re hiring a Director of Network Strategy & Planning to own the design of the Parcel network: where packages enter, how they move and sort, how they reach the door, and the planning systems that decide all of it. Your decisions in the first 12 months will set the cost and service curve for Parcel for years, building on an existing local logistics network and what the team has built over the last 2-3 years.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Design short and long term topology plan for a network, and evaluate long term investments 3-5 years and solving near term P&L opportunities
Design the Parcel network end to end, including where packages enter, sort, and travel, and decide by city whether to build, lease, or partner. Design speed tenants, and customer facing experiences.
Set the delivery promise, cut-off times, and capacity plans for peak season and disruptions, and review plan versus actual results every week.
Turn package volume into delivery routes that are attractive to Dashers and profitable for DoorDash, and design pickup and long-distance trucking between sites with partner carriers.
Build the planning tools with Engineering and Data Science, prototyping simulation and optimization yourself with AI and Python before asking for headcount.
Be measured on speed, cost per package, network productivity, Dasher experience, and reliability, reviewed weekly as ranges rather than averages.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 12+ years of substantial experience leading strategy and operations in a complex, high-growth business, with a track record of building new offerings and scaling them into sustainable businesses.
You have deep experience designing or running parcel, last-mile, or logistics networks, including site design, package flow, and routing.
You have owned cost and service results for a network and make decisions based on data, including when the data disagrees with the plan.
You work well with Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to turn prototypes into products.
You move quickly and care about the details, such as testing in one city, reading the results, and then scaling or stopping.

title: Head of Program Management, DoorDash Air
description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!
About the Role
We're hiring a Head of Program Management for DoorDash Air, our in-house drone delivery program. DoorDash Air is an FAA Part 135 certified air carrier, flying aircraft we design and build ourselves. In this role, you'll run the program end to end: launching and scaling our commercial drone delivery service while we build the next generation of aircraft. You'll report to the Head of DoorDash Air and sit on the Air leadership team as a peer to every functional lead, across hardware, autonomy, software, systems, reliability, flight operations, supply chain and product. This role is in person at our San Francisco office, with regular time at our test sites.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Play an integral role on a small and focused team
Own the integrated plan for DoorDash Air across aircraft, autonomy, software, ground infrastructure, flight operations, safety and merchant integration
Run two programs at once: scale commercial service on today's aircraft and build the next-generation aircraft
Set and run the gates that decide when we launch, when we scale, and when a design is ready for production
Find the critical path across hardware, software and operations, and clear it with the leads who own each piece
Shape how program management operates across Air, partnering with our TPMs and functional leads as engineering grows
Bring program status, risks and decisions to DoorDash's executive leadership
Help evaluate external aircraft partners and suppliers
We're excited about you because…
You have 10+ years building aircraft, robots or autonomous vehicles, and you've led a hardware and software program through commercial launch or regulatory approval
You're technical enough to challenge a schedule and work a design trade with the engineers who own it
You've set launch, safety or reliability gates and held them under pressure
You've led complex programs through TPMs and functional leaders, including teams outside your reporting line
You write plans and decisions that executives and engineers both act on
You do your best work on small, senior teams where everyone wears more than one hat
You're driven by a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences
BS/MS/PhD in an engineering or related technical field, or equivalent experience
Nice to have experience includes:
Drone delivery, eVTOL or other aviation programs, including flight test
FAA operations or certification (Part 107, Part 135, BVLOS)
Reliability growth programs for safety-critical hardware
New product introduction and contract manufacturing
Technical diligence of external partners or suppliers
Running a program office through a fast headcount ramp
Why You'll Love Working at DoorDash
We are leaders – Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are operators – We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions to lead our company and our industry is what we do on every project, every day.
We are learners – Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or one minute. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our customers, merchants, and dashers.
We are one team – The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

description:
About the role
We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to shape how DashPass delivers more value through affordability and new benefits. You'll join the Affordability pod within New Benefits, turning emerging customer needs into experiences that make everyday purchases more accessible and membership more valuable.
This is a hands-on role with room to define the problem, set direction, and build. You'll work directly with product, engineering, research, analytics, and business partners to identify opportunities, test new concepts, and bring them to market. You'll connect a longer-term vision to the next experiment, staying close to the interaction, visual, and implementation details that make an experience feel simple and considered.
We're building a team of designers who combine deep craft with the ability to bring ideas to life. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to explore possibilities, build working prototypes, and shorten the path from an idea to a shipped experience. Your judgment will shape both what we build and how the team builds it.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Set direction in an emerging space. Turn customer insights, business goals, and incomplete inputs into a clear point of view, product briefs, and a sequence of experiments and launches.
Influence what gets built. Build alignment with product and engineering leaders, shape priorities across the pod and adjacent teams, and resolve tradeoffs between customer value, feasibility, and business impact.
Own the work from concept through launch. Move between problem framing, exploration, prototyping, and implementation, taking initiative to close gaps and keep the work moving.
Deliver a high bar for craft. Create intuitive flows, precise visual design, and thoughtful interactions that make benefits and savings easy to understand and use, with accessibility and consistency built in.
Build with AI. Use AI-assisted design and coding to make realistic prototypes, test ideas with customers, and contribute product improvements alongside engineers. Create reusable tools and workflows that help teammates move faster while preserving quality.
Ship, learn, and improve. Partner with research and analytics to define success, evaluate experiments, and improve experiences based on customer understanding, benefit adoption, and membership engagement.
Multiply the team's impact. Coach designers on craft and product thinking, share effective AI workflows, and strengthen shared patterns and hiring practices that raise the team's quality bar.
We're excited about you because…
Your body of shipped work demonstrates refined visual and interaction design, thoughtful systems thinking, and attention to the details of the final product.
You've taken ambiguous opportunities from problem definition to launch, shaping what a team built and demonstrating what changed for customers and the business.
You establish priorities and make progress with limited direction, identifying missing inputs, bringing the right partners together, and making decisions as new evidence emerges.
You've influenced roadmaps and earned alignment across product, engineering, and business partners through clear reasoning, customer evidence, and tangible prototypes.
AI is already part of how you work. You can show working prototypes, product changes, or reusable tools you've built with AI, explain your own contribution, and evaluate the quality of the output.
You work directly with engineers on implementation, understand technical constraints, and use code to explore and refine an experience.
You know when to explore broadly and when to narrow scope, balancing speed, craft, and customer value. You strengthen the work around you through critique, coaching, and shared practices.

People Product builds the internal products the People team runs on across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, including the surfaces and automated workflows for every employee support experience. Our team operates at two levels: we are experts in our specific People products, and we are the centralized People product team that defines the product standards, quality, and measures for all product managers across the People team.
About the Role
We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own products for the People team's human resources (HR) partner products. These products support the specialized HR and HR-adjacent teams  (e.g., Employee Relations) whose expertise the broader People team relies on to support employees. You'll work closely with them to discover the pain points that keep them from their highest-value work, apply product judgment to define the problems and the solutions that augment or automate high-cost workflows, and set a clear vision for where human judgment remains essential. Success is measured in cost, quality, and time for these teams, with experience standards as the floor.
You will report into the Senior Manager, People Product on our People Product team in our Technology, Insights & Operations organization.

Set the product vision and roadmap across the HR Partner team, and move People leaders at DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt from one-off requests to a shared plan they help set.

title: Executive Assistant - Office of the CEO
description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
Impact In This Role
The Executive Assistant is the operational engine behind the President & CEO’s day. This person owns the calendar, travel and inbox so the President & CEO can focus on the highest priorities, and handles scheduling requests from across the company. The role also prepares itineraries for multi-day trips and events involving the President & CEO, and supports company events.
The role sits in the Office of the CEO team and reports to the Chief of Staff, while serving as executive assistant to the President & CEO. Because the role sees very sensitive information, discretion is essential.
What You’ll Be Doing
Executive & Calendar Support
Own President & CEO's calendar end-to-end — complex scheduling, prioritization, and proactive management of conflicts across multiple time zones
Anticipate scheduling needs before they arise; protect time for high-priority work and thinking
Prepare President & CEO for meetings with relevant context, briefings, and materials
Manage high-volume email; draft correspondence, flag action items, and ensure timely follow-through
Coordinate and manage complex meeting cadences across the Executive Leadership Team and extended leadership organization, including agenda preparation, pre-read distribution, and post-meeting action item tracking to ensure decisions are captured and followed through
Coordinate closely with the Chief of Staff to align on priorities and ensure nothing is missed
Travel Planning & Logistics
Plan and book complex domestic and international travel — flights, hotels, ground transport, visas — often on short notice with changing itineraries
Travel with President & CEO on select high-priority trips to provide on-the-ground support
Build detailed travel itineraries and anticipate logistics at every step
Manage travel expenses and reconcile reports accurately and on time
Meeting & Event Coordination
Coordinate executive leadership team meetings and offsites, including gathering agendas, logistics, and tracking follow-ups
Support All Hands meetings and company-wide events — managing AV, Zoom, run of show, and speaker coordination
Manage conference room calendars and troubleshoot tech issues in real time
Administrative & Special Projects
Maintain and update critical documentation, expense reports, and organizational records
Support confidential projects with the highest level of discretion
Assist with external relations, executive outreach, and stakeholder communications as needed
Take on special projects at the direction of President & CEO and the Chief of Staff
Please note: All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.
Desired Traits
5+ years of executive assistant experience, ideally supporting a C-suite executive in a fast-paced tech or startup environment
Discreet and trustworthy: handles sensitive personal and professional information with complete professionalism
Exceptionally organized, with a bias toward systems and proactive planning
Clear communicator, written and verbal, who can represent the President & CEO's voice when needed
Calm under pressure and decisive when priorities change
Comfortable managing up: keeps a busy executive on track without overstepping
Tech-driven: proficient with Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom and travel booking platforms, picks up new tools quickly, and uses AI to support and improve workflows
Resourceful and self-directed: finds solutions before problems become visible
Able to work on site with the Office of the CEO team
Japanese language proficiency is a plus, but not required
Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Primarily office-based work with prolonged computer use.
Occasionally lifts event materials of up to 25 lbs.
Up to 25% domestic and international travel to support the President & CEO on select trips and to support company events.
Perks and Benefits
Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401K plan
Parental leave programs
Paid volunteer days
And much, much more!
Salary Range: $110,000 to $125,000 per year, depending upon experience
Interested in learning more?  We look forward to hearing from you soon.
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

Develop and maintain relationships with maintenance, operations, procurement, and engineering teams across assigned accounts
Identify and grow opportunities by understanding site-level maintenance needs, spend, and reliability challenges
Apply engineering and technical knowledge to evaluate customer applications, review component requirements and specifications, and recommend the right solutions
Promote MISUMI Americas Factory Automation solutions to improve uptime, reduce total cost, and increase overall share
Provide customer feedback to internal teams to support MRO product, service, and inventory program development
Create and deliver presentations, proposals, and account plans for customer stakeholders and internal leadership
Apply consultative selling strategies to expand MRO revenue

Collaborate cross-functionally to support account execution and ongoing customer needs
Support on-site account development and relationship building

title: Senior Strategic Account Marketing Lead
description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
Impact In This Role
As the Senior Strategic Account Marketing Lead at MISUMI Americas, you will work side by side with the sales reps who own your assigned accounts. You will take their account plans, what customers are telling us, and our revenue goals, and turn them into practical, creative marketing campaigns. These campaigns should spark engagement, create and move deals forward, and strengthen customer relationships.
This is not a role for a single-channel specialist. You will build and lead growth plans for each account, using both hands-on and large-scale tactics. These include customer visits, lunch-and-learns, direct mail and swag, executive outreach, events, targeted email and nurture programs, paid ads, sales support materials, and account-specific content. You do not have to create every asset or run every channel yourself. You do need to pick the right mix, bring in the right partners, and see the work through to results you can measure.
What You’ll Be Doing
Become a trusted, proactive marketing partner to the Account Executives and sales leaders for a named portfolio of Strategic and Key Accounts. Maintain a regular operating cadence with each seller to understand account priorities, opportunities, whitespace, risks, and next steps.
Translate account plans, account research, buyer and buying-group insights, intent signals, opportunity data, and customer engagement into focused account-growth strategies and quarterly activation plans.
Own the end-to-end planning, orchestration, and execution of 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many account marketing programs. Select the right mix of high-touch and scalable tactics based on the account objective, buying stage, audience, and expected impact.
Develop creative, practical account plays that help Sales earn attention and create momentum. Examples include customer-office visits, lunch-and-learns, executive meetings, local customer experiences, direct mail and swag, targeted events, customer workshops, outbound support, account-specific content, and digital nurture programs.
Partner with Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, Field and Events, Content, Product Marketing, Design, Sales Development, and external vendors to activate cohesive campaigns. Write clear briefs, establish ownership and timelines, resolve blockers, and ensure every program is delivered to a high bar.
Work with Web, Lifecycle and Performance Marketing to create and optimize targeted email, nurture, retargeting, paid media, landing-page, and audience programs for assigned accounts when those tactics will advance the account objective.
Drive customers and prospects to MISUMI Americas events and create thoughtful pre-event, onsite, and post-event account plans that convert event participation into meaningful sales follow-up and pipeline progress.
Work with Content and PMMs to build the sales enablement required for each activation, including messaging, outreach guidance, follow-up plans, templates, snippets, talking points, and clear seller actions. Ensure Sales understands the plan and follows through.
Manage assigned program budgets and vendors with an ROI mindset. Test, learn, reallocate investment, and know when to stop, revise, or scale an account play.
Use Salesforce, Marketo, Reachdesk, Sigma, intent data, account engagement data, and other available signals to identify opportunity, prioritize investment, and measure impact. Maintain a clear view of account engagement, buying-group reach, opportunity creation and progression, pipeline, conversion, velocity, win rate, and revenue influence.
Share account-level learnings, results, and recommendations with Sales and Marketing. Turn successful plays into repeatable programs and quickly address underperforming tactics.
Execute directly when speed and quality require it. This role is expected to be a hands-on operator, not solely a strategist, coordinator, or requester of work from other teams.
Travel to customer offices, MISUMI Americas events, industry events, and internal meetings when in-person engagement can accelerate an account objective.
How We’ll Measure Success
Success in this role is measured by business impact and sales-partner effectiveness, not campaign activity alone. In the first year, this person will:
Establish productive working relationships and a clear account-growth cadence with the sellers for their assigned Strategic and Key Accounts.
Deliver account plans and integrated activations that are directly tied to seller priorities, customer needs, and pipeline goals.
Increase meaningful engagement with priority contacts and buying groups, create or advance qualified opportunities, and contribute to pipeline progression, opportunity velocity, win rate, and revenue across the supported portfolio.
Build repeatable, data-informed account plays that combine high-touch experiences with scalable lifecycle and performance tactics.
Earn a reputation with Sales and Marketing for creativity, responsiveness, sound judgment, operational follow-through, and measurable impact.
What Makes This Role Different
This role sits at the intersection of account strategy, field execution, digital activation, and sales partnership. It is not limited to digital marketing, paid media, event production, project management, or account research. Candidates must bring broad marketing judgment and be comfortable moving between customer-facing experiences, account-specific campaigns, and scaled programs.
The role owns the account marketing strategy, activation plan, cross-functional orchestration, seller adoption, and performance readout for the assigned portfolio. Channel and functional teams provide their specialized expertise; this role brings those capabilities together into the right account solution and owns the outcome.
Desired Traits
8+ years of B2B marketing experience in account-based marketing, strategic account marketing, field marketing, demand generation, or a closely related revenue-marketing role.
Demonstrated experience partnering directly with enterprise, strategic, or key-account sellers to build and execute account plans that contributed to pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue.
Proven ability to develop and execute integrated campaigns across both high-touch and digital channels, including customer events or experiences, direct mail or gifting, sales outreach support, email or nurture, paid or performance programs, and content.
Track record of taking programs from insight and strategy through detailed execution, optimization, and performance reporting.

title: Staff Validation Engineer, Electrical Systems
description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is hiring a Staff Validation Engineer, Electrical Systems to join our Electrical & Software Test organization. In this role you will be the technical lead for system-level testing of electrical, software, and control systems on test assets that deliver learnings on our Power Conversion Systems (DC/DC, inverter, etc.) and Network Systems (plant-level communications, etc.). These assets are a cornerstone of our validation strategy.



You will be deeply accountable for identifying, planning, and executing system-level tests that deliver learnings to our Power Conversion Systems and Network Systems teams, and for turning those learnings into design changes, requirements, and product-readiness decisions. The ideal candidate pairs rigorous technical depth and first-principles thinking with the leadership required to align cross-functional teams and mentor growing engineers and technicians.



This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the scaling of our battery technology and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Identify the system-level tests, test assets, and operating conditions needed to retire the highest-risk electrical, software, and control system unknowns.

 - Architect comprehensive test plans and procedures that validate Power Conversion Systems (DC/DC, inverter) and Network Systems (plant-level communications) behaviors across electrical, software, and control layers.

 - Act as the primary technical bridge between design teams (electrical hardware, software, controls), test engineering, and product management to translate high-level requirements into executable validation strategies.

 - Partner closely with Site Operations and Facilities teams to manage the infrastructure footprint, power requirements, safety protocols (hazard reviews, FMEA), and continuous uptime of test assets.

 - Lead the day-to-day execution of test campaigns. When anomalies occur, spearhead root-cause analysis (RCA) and triage across electrical hardware, software, controls, and test infrastructure.

 - Synthesize complex test data into clear, actionable engineering reports and leadership dashboards to gate product milestones.

 - Act as a force multiplier by coaching, mentoring, and leveling up junior engineers and test technicians.

 - Champion a culture of safety, cleanliness, 5S, and rigorous documentation within the testing lab environment.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 8+ years of experience in systems validation, integration testing, or hardware test engineering (ideally within power electronics, grid storage, renewables, electric vehicles, or aerospace).

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Controls, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

 - Deep familiarity with power conversion hardware (DC/DC converters, inverters, rectifiers), high-voltage power distribution, protection, and control architectures.

 - Experience with high-power industrial systems, grid-tied equipment, or power electronics at utility or industrial scale.

 - Proficiency with test automation frameworks (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB/Simulink) and data analysis pipelines for high-rate electrical data.

 - Familiarity with network protocols standard to industrial, grid, and automotive systems (CAN, Modbus, Ethernet, EtherCAT, DNP3, IEC 61850).

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving hardware startup environment; able to carve out a path forward when requirements are fluid.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and present test findings to design, controls, and leadership audiences in a fast-paced environment.

Develop, validate, and document hardware solutions that meet clinical and environmental requirements.

Intuitive understanding of mechanical phenomena with ability to do rigorous analysis.

Experience with UL, CE, IEC 60601, and/or FDA regulatory requirements for medical devices.
Experience with corrective and preventive action (CAPA) investigations, driving corrective actions to closure.
Experience with signal integrity in mixed-signal/power environments.
Familiarity with motion control or feedback control systems.
Exposure to FPGA logic design, tools, and verification processes.
Proficiency with relevant business tools: Agile PLM, SAP, Polarion, JIRA, Confluence, etc.
Knowledge of C, Python, MATLAB, or other programming/scripting languages.

Primary Function of Position
The Future Forward group within Intuitive Surgical is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineering Technician to support early-stage R&D of next-generation flexible energy delivery instruments and accessories. This is a hybrid role: you’ll build and iterate functional prototypes from early engineering concepts, and you’ll also support dosimetry-focused testing (benchtop, ex vivo, and in vivo) to help the team understand the energy dose delivered to tissue and resulting tissue effects. The candidate should be comfortable working with minimal supervision, and with minimal work instructions and be able to take ideas from R&D engineers and figure out how to build fully functional instrument prototypes. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented, comfortable with minimal supervision, and able to translate rough direction into reliable builds, experiments, and data.
Essential Job Duties
Builds and refines medical device components and catheter assemblies and provide input for the catheter assembly.
Assisting with all aspects of early prototype builds, including procurement of material, inspection of materials and subassemblies, rework of components, assembly, troubleshooting, and repair of prototype instruments.
Prepare instruments/electrodes/fixtures/tissue samples and run experiments from approved protocols.
Support preclinical lab evaluations (including in vivo), equipment setup, and procedural assistance as needed.
Perform tissue handling and histology prep activities (orientation/inking/trimming, fixation, cassette prep, labeling, sample tracking); coordinate outsourced histology and perform cryosectioning when applicable.
Assisting engineers in benchtop and excised tissue lab evaluations of prototypes
Collecting, recording, and reporting test results.
Preparation of prototype instruments and accessories for benchtop testing and pre-clinical lab evaluations, organizing, overseeing, and collaborating with other groups to assemble and test prototypes.
Setup, organization, and maintenance of engineering lab and equipment.
Documenting assembly procedures and training other technicians on assembly.
Assisting in knowledge transfer to other groups / teams.
Required Skills and Experience
5+ years R&D technician experience in medical device development
Minimum Associate of Science degree, or equivalent work experience
Strong hands-on prototyping/assembly skills and comfort working from limited work instructions.
Hands-on skills and knowledgeable in prototyping and manufacturing methods, including soldering, microscopic wire and cable stripping, use of rotary tools, drills, small hand tools and adhesive bonding.
Knowledge of catheter materials and manufacturing processes including laminating, braiding, bonding, flaring, tipping.
Manual dexterity to assemble small components, with microscope or similar magnification.
Experience running benchtop and/or tissue-based testing; comfortable in an animal lab environment.
Experience with tissue prep for histology and meticulous sample/data record keeping.
Proficiency with Excel/Word/PowerPoint; familiarity with ImageJ or similar image analysis tools.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Cryosectioning and outsourced histology submission experience.
Basic electrical measurement experience (multimeter/oscilloscope) and metrology tools (calipers/micrometers/vision)
Knowledge of medical grade adhesives.
Ability to inspect components using metrology equipment (including calipers, micrometers, vision systems, CMM).
Computer skills in Microsoft Office required, SolidWorks experience desirable.
Excellent organizational skills.
Able to work independently.
Strong design to learn and apply new technology.

This position requires an individual with strong technical and interpersonal skills, the ability to work effectively and collaboratively with highly technical peers, and the capability to manage work load among multiple priorities. Architect and maintain robust automation frameworks to support product quality and scalability

Collaborate closely with developers, UI/UX designers,  and other software test team members, driving continuous improvements in our testing processes and results.
Influence and negotiate with software developers to deliver important interfaces between test automation and product software.
Develop requirement/specifications and perform validation for test automation tools.
Identify, report, and help resolve defects and inconsistencies with the tests/framework.
Support formal Verification and Validation activities (perform test execution, write reports, verify JIRA tickets).

Contribute to code reviews and support automation best practices within the team.
Prepare and maintain test documentation, including status reports and metrics on automation efforts.
Mentor other team members to build automation expertise within the team
